newsitem.title: GREECE: Greece to auction 200 bln drs of bonds in March.
newsitem.headline: Greece to auction 200 bln drs of bonds in March.

text.p: The Greek finance ministry will auction about 200 billion drachmas of long-term bonds in March to cover expiries, Deputy Finance Minister Nickos Christodoulakis told a news conference.
"We are seeking financing for about 200 billion drachmas through long-term bonds," said Christodoulakis. "Our intention is to extend the maturity of public debt."
He said there were expiries of about 126 billion drachmas in early March and 80 billion drachmas at the end of the month.
Asked what he meant by long-term bonds, he said they could be seven-year FRNs, three-year fixed coupon bonds or even 5-year coupon bonds.
"We will make an announcement next week," said Christodoulakis.
Greece has never issued or auctioned 5-year coupon bonds
